Title: Intent to Sole Source - Cyber Training Course
Description: NOTICE OF INTENT TO AWARD A SOLE SOURCE CONTRACT The Air Force District of Washington, HQ USSF Enterprise Support Division (AFDW/PKF), intends to award a sole-source Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA) to Purdue University, 2550 Northwestern Ave #1100, West Lafayette, IN 47906, for continued delivery of the Cyber Training Course. AFDW/PKF intends to use commercial acquisition procedures and other than full and open competition. The authority permitting other than full and open competition is RFO 6.103-1, Only One Source, as implemented through RFO 12.201-2 and 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1), when only one responsible source is capable of satisfying the Government’s requirement. Purdue University developed the existing Cyber Training Course under Contract FA701425P0042 and possesses the unique course knowledge, instructional approach, training materials, cyber lab structure, and technical expertise required to continue performance without unacceptable delays, duplication of effort, or disruption to the established curriculum. This notice is not a request for competitive quotations, proposals, or capability statements. No solicitation or request for quotation will be issued. However, interested parties may identify their interest and submit relevant capability information in response to this notice. Information received will normally be considered only for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement. Title: Title XI Vessel Surveys and Appraisals Support Services
Description: DISCLAIMER: This is a Sources Sought Notice and is for informational and planning purposes only. This is not a Solicitation, Request for Proposal (RFP), or Invitation for Bid (IFB). Responses to this notice are not considered offers and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. The Government will not reimburse respondents for any costs incurred in responding to this notice. BACKGROUND: The Maritime Administration (MARAD) is conducting market research to identify qualified small business concerns capable of providing vessel surveys, vessel appraisals, and related maritime technical support services in support of the Title XI Federal Ship Financing Program and other Federal lending-related maritime activities. The Government is seeking information from firms with demonstrated experience in conducting marine vessel inspections, technical evaluations, condition and valuation surveys, and appraisals for commercial vessels and maritime assets for either Federal lending programs or private-sector financing institutions. SCOPE OF POTENTIAL REQUIREMENT: The anticipated services may include, but are not limited to: • Vessel condition surveys • Vessel valuation and appraisal reports • Technical inspections and assessments • Review of vessel maintenance and operational records • Risk and collateral analysis for maritime lending purposes • Shipyard and construction progress inspections • Compliance reviews related to marine financing programs • Preparation of written technical findings and recommendations • Support for Federal credit underwriting and loan monitoring activities The Government is particularly interested in identifying small businesses with expertise involving commercial vessels, ship financing, marine engineering, vessel operations, and maritime asset valuation. SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS: Interested firms shall submit an electronic capability statement in PDF format. Responses shall be submitted via email to: Kelly Mitchell-Carroll K.Mitchell-Carroll@dot.gov Subject Line: “Sources Sought Response – Title XI Vessel Surveys and Appraisals” Responses are due no later than: June 8, 2026, at 12 Noon, EDT QUESTIONS: Questions regarding this notice may be submitted via email to the Contract Specialist identified above no later than June 3, 2026, by 12 Noon, EDT. IMPORTANT NOTICE: This Sources Sought Notice is issued solely for market research purposes to assist the Government in acquisition planning and determining the availability of qualified small business sources. The Government reserves the right to determine the appropriate acquisition strategy based on responses received. See the attached for further detail as it relates to this Sources Sought Notice.

Title: Basic Electronics Training Courses
Description: This is a presolicitation notice, published in accordance with FAR 5.101(c). The United States Secret Service (USSS) intends to award a sole source, Firm Fixed Price (FFP) Purchase Order (PO) to: Ridgeline International LLC. 255 Greensboro Dr., Suite 500. Tysons Corner, VA 22102. The proposed contract action is for Basic Electronics Training Courses; NAICS: 611710 – Educational Support Services; PSC Code: U008 - Education/Training- Training/Curriculum Development A determination by the Government not to compete this requirement on a full and open competitive basis, upon receipt of responses to this notice, is solely within the discretion of the Government. It is the Government's intent to proceed with this sole-source action. The Government has determined that the acquisition circumstances deem only one source is available, and the basis for the decision is pursuant to FAR 12.102(a) (FAR Class Deviation 25-21). Explanation for lack of competition: Ridgeline International LLC previously adopted a standard electronics training curriculum to address the specific operational needs of the United States Secret Service (USSS). This adaptation resulted in a USSS-specific course load that is not available from any other vendor currently due to the specificity of the course material that was tailored to the learning needs of the Technical Security Division. The coursework includes the principles of electronic security systems, specifically identifying and describing the components and functions of electronic security equipment commonly deployed by USSS, Technical Security Division (TSD). This notice is not a request for competitive quotations or proposals; however, all responsible sources may submit a response to include a capability statement clearly documenting the offeror’s capability to provide the items/services in this notice. No telephone responses will be accepted. Any information submitted by respondents is strictly voluntary. Submission of a capability statement does not guarantee this requirement will become a competitive procurement. Information received will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether conducting a competitive procurement in the future is in the best interest of the government. No formal solicitation will be issued. Requests for copies of a solicitation in response to this notice will not be honored. Responses shall be emailed to the Contracting Officer, Crystal Garcia crystal.garcia@usss.dhs.gov and the Contracting Specialist, Shannon Fletcher, shannon.fletcher@associates.usss.dhs.gov

Title: Remediation and Restoration
Description: The purpose of this solicitation/quote is to provide support to the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Facilities Environmental Cleanup (ECU) Program. As part of this effort, a Remedial Action (RA) will be conducted at two facilities in the FAA Eastern Service Area (ESA) to remove identified soil contamination sites as cited hereunder. The FAA facilities to be addressed are located in Conyers, GA and Bloomingdale, GA. The FAA’s ECU Program has identified the potential for environmental and human health risks and/or liability associated with the facilities above based on prior research, known historic operations and practices, and required cleanup actions or previously identified sites. The Contractor shall conduct all work in accordance with Federal, State and local requirements. Where inconsistencies exist, the Contractor shall follow the most stringent requirementThe Contractor shall submit a draft Remediation and Restoration work plan (Work Plan) (where applicable) within ten (10) business days of the project kick-off meeting that addresses the project requirements below.. This task involves the preparation and submission of a draft and final Work Plan. The Work Plan shall detail the technical approach and schedule for conducting all contaminated soil remediation, disposal, and site restoration activities described below. To assist with preparation of the Work Plan, the contractor shall thoroughly review the Government-furnished information (GFI) for pertinent information. The removal quantities and depths in the Preliminary Assessment/Site Investigation and Remedial Investigation reports (if provided) are to be used as a guide along with the estimated total quantities listed in this SOW Section 2.2.2. The Work Plan shall describe methods and procedures for performing soil remediation, disposal, and restoration. Disposal methods must be detailed by the contractor for all sites including the identification of all disposal facilities where waste and debris is to be shipped. Disposal sampling and paperwork is the responsibility of the contractor. The government will perform ALL confirmatory sampling required at the sites. Additionally, the work plan shall also identify any required permits needed to perform the work. Additional components required with the Work Plan are the Site Safety and Health Plan (SSHP), which shall include personnel health and safety precautions to be followed. The work plan shall also include a brief Risk Management Plan that identifies major risks and hazards on each site and discusses ways to minimize these risks. (see SOW for more details).

Submission must be received not later than May 20, 2026. Late submissions will be treated in accordance with the solicitation provision at FAR 52.212-1(c). All quotes must be submitted via email to Beth Wilson at beth_wilson@ios.doi.gov. Any questions or concerns regarding this solicitation should be forwarded in writing via e-mail to Beth Wilson at beth_wilson@ios.doi.gov. All responsible sources may submit a quotation, which will be considered by the agency.

Title: H2F Gym and Fitness Equipment for Camp Casey, Korea
Description: The contractor shall provide all labor, tools, equipment and supplies to deliver Gym equipment and flooring to Camp Casey, in order to support 2ID Soldier fitness and readiness. This purchase order shall include installation of the flooring. Basis of Award: Using simplified procedures in RFO FAR Part 12.201-1, the Government intends to award a firm fixed-price contract resulting from this Request for Quotation (RFQ) to the responsible vendor whose quotation represents the Best Value to the Government. Evaluation Factors: a. Technical Specification: Vendors must meet the technical specifications outlined in the Pricing Sheet. Offers will be evaluated as either Acceptable or Unacceptable. Quotes evaluated as Unacceptable will not be considered further for award. b. Price: Evaluated for completeness and reasonableness. The Government will evaluate the total price, including all shipping/FOB Destination charges. c. Delivery schedule: The Government requires delivery on an accelerated schedule. The required delivery date is No-Later-Than (NLT) 30 Days After Receipt of Order. Vendors shall propose their best and most aggressive delivery schedule in their response. Quotes offering delivery earlier than the NLT date will be evaluated favorably. Relative Importance: Technical Specification is evaluated on an Acceptable/Unacceptable basis. Among those quotes determined to be technically Acceptable, Delivery Schedule is equal to Price. The Government will use comparative evaluation procedures to evaluate quotations as per RFO FAR Part 12.203 (c) (2). The Government will compare quotations side-by-side to determine which provides the best value. The Government reserves the right to select a quotation that is better than the lowest-priced quotation if the Government determines that the accelerated delivery schedule of the higher-priced quotation justifies the additional cost. The Government intends to evaluate quotations and make award without exchanges; however, the Government reserves the right to conduct communications if determined necessary by the Contracting Officer. ***Please see attached Pricing Sheet and Solicitation for additional information.*** SUBMIT QUOTES VIA SAM.GOV
